Job Description:Our Client is looking for a skilled Python Full Stack Developer to design, build, and deploy intelligent web applications. Qualifications & Required Skills: Strong proficiency in Python with hands-on experience building RESTful APIs and microservices.Proven experience developing modern web applications using Angular and React.Direct hands-on experience integrating Azure AI Services (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Search, Language/Vision APIs) into production applications.Experience working with SQL/NoSQL databases, asynchronous programming, and secure API integrations.

Preferred Skill: Experience with vector databases, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures, or LLM orchestrators (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel).Familiarity with Azure DevOps, CI/CD automation pipelines, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).Knowledge of state management, testing frameworks (PyTest, Jest), and UI component libraries.
